name: admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: instance_admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: vrfs
desc: List of MSDP VRF configurations. - Map key: `name` - VRF name.

name: vrfs[*].group_limits
desc: List of MSDP group limits per source prefix. - Map key: `source_prefix` - Source prefix.

name: vrfs[*].originator_interface
desc: Originator Interface identifying IP address in RP field of Source-Active message. Supported interfaces include Ethernet-like, port/channel, loopback and vlan interfaces.

name: vrfs[*].peers
desc: List of MSDP peers. - Map key: `address` - IP address of MSDP Peer.

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].authentication_key_wo
desc: The write-only value of the attribute.

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].authentication_key_wo_version
desc: The write-only version of the attribute.

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].authentication_keychain
desc: Name of the Keychain Used For Authentication.

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].keepalive_interval
desc: Keepalive interval, how often you send keepalives. - Range: `1`-`60`

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].sa_policies
desc: List of MSDP Source Active route control policies. - Map key: `direction` - Direction. - Key choices: `in`, `out`

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].sa_policies[*].prefix_list
desc: Prefix list to control the distribution.

name: vrfs[*].peers[*].source_interface
desc: Source Interface. Supported interfaces include Ethernet-like, port/channel, loopback and vlan interfaces.

name: vrfs[*].redistribution_route_map
desc: The name of the default route leak policy route map. This route map name is used to control distribution.

name: vrfs[*].redistribution_scope
desc: The domain applicable to the capability. - Choices: `intra`, `inter`, `defrt`

name: vrfs[*].redistribution_source
desc: Source of route leak distribution. - Choices: `none`, `pflist`, `rtmap`
